title: JCPenney - Omni International Mall
address:
1701 Biscayne Blvd
Miami, Florida 33132
United States
description:
BDI Construction completed a full building demolition of the former JCPenney department store at Omni International Mall in Miami, bringing down the multi-level structure to clear the site for its next phase.

The project also included remodeling and repair work across the broader mall property, supporting redevelopment of this landmark Biscayne Boulevard site.
